#!/bin/bash
# Runs once, as root, before the agent starts: Harbor's [environment.healthcheck] unpacks this folder into
# /var/lib/mimo and runs it. Generated by mimo_harbor; see its README for how each step maps to Xiaomi's harness.
M=/var/lib/mimo
[ -f "$M/ready" ] && exit 0
chmod 700 "$M"
fail() { echo "setup: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
# the answer-leak blocklist (mimoagent), applied to /etc/hosts by the agent right after it installs
write_blocklist() { cp "$M/files/blocklist" "$M/blocklist"; }

mkdir -p /app

# music-prefetch-abcmidi@1: grading needs abc2midi; install it now while the network is open.
if ! command -v abc2midi >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apt-get update -qq >/dev/null && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends abcmidi=20250216+ds-1 >/dev/null \
    || fail "music-prefetch-abcmidi@1 could not install abcmidi"
fi
command -v abc2midi >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "music-prefetch-abcmidi@1: abc2midi still missing after install"
touch "$M/ready"
echo "setup done"

schema_version = "1.4"

[task]
name = "mimo-v2.6-rl/music-gk-1078"
description = "Chinese-style pop in D minor"
keywords = ["mimo-v2.6-rl", "music"]

[metadata]
adapter = "mimo_harbor 1.1.0"
category = "Pop & modern"
domain = "music"
keywords = ["music", "Pop & modern", "Chinese-style pop", "4/4", "5 voices", "Moderate (80–120)", "Chinese"]
reference_harness = "XiaomiMiMo/verl a2ad9f6 + XiaomiMiMo/mimoagent 467f0a1"
reference_response_length = 100000
reference_step_limit = 4
source_dataset = "XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-RL-oss"
source_id = "music-gK-1078"
source_revision = "639865fd3374018d6cb29b9fb82dd531406fcf5f"
title = "Chinese-style pop in D minor"

[agent]
timeout_sec = 900.0

[verifier]
timeout_sec = 600.0
user = "root"

[environment]
docker_image = "docker.io/library/python@sha256:f77ac9e44ae96ef2c90b8053ea08c31f8be030f824196b0ae4db6d462c84e51f"
workdir = "/app"
cpus = 1
memory_mb = 2048
network_mode = "public"
build_timeout_sec = 1800.0

[environment.healthcheck]
# one-time setup before the agent (environment/setup/setup.sh)
command = "bash -c 'test -f /var/lib/mimo/ready || { mkdir -p /var/lib/mimo && echo  | base64 -d | tar -xzf - -C /var/lib/mimo && bash /var/lib/mimo/setup.sh; }'"
timeout_sec = 1200.0
retries = 0
interval_sec = 5.0

rationale: Grading apt-installs abcmidi at grade time and fails unscored once the egress lock blocks the network; setup installs the same pinned abcmidi version before the agent starts, while the network is open, failing setup if it cannot. The grader already skips its install when abc2midi is present, so grading never touches the network. Grading, instruction and image are unchanged.

inputs.arch_note: version-pinned apt install with no architecture qualifier; apt resolves the image-arch build (amd64 on Daytona, arm64 locally)
